verdict.rationale: xAI publishes machine-readable docs (llms.txt, openapi.json) and a quickstart with example prompts/code, showing a structured API reference exists, but there is no evidence of an interactive 'try it now' console or in-browser runnable examples typical of tools like Swagger UI or Postman-style explorers. Missing for 10: interactive in-browser code execution/sandbox, live request/response try-it widget, independent confirmation of an interactive reference UI.
